t: This is the Delfina Foundation, an independent, non-profit organisation that supports artistic exchange and creative practice through residencies, partnerships and public programmes. It was founded by Delfina Entrecanales, a Spanish-born arts patron and philanthropist who lived in England from 1946 and was awarded a CBE. Her name is on the door, and the foundation she created is still built around bringing artists together and giving them room to develop their work.
